---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an addition or change to the SDK, a sample app, or the docs
title: ""
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

What are you trying to do that the SDK doesn't currently support, or does support awkwardly?
Concrete scenario preferred over an abstract one.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see. If you have an idea of the shape of the API (a new `DevConsoleConfig`
field, a new inspector, a new adapter module, etc.), sketch it here.

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds you're using today, or other approaches you considered and ruled out.

## Which part of the SDK

- [ ] Core / facade (`sdk:api`, `sdk:full`, `sdk:noop`)
- [ ] Network / socket / mocks capture (`sdk:network*`, `sdk:socket*`, `sdk:mocks*`)
- [ ] Push (`sdk:push*`)
- [ ] State / feature flags (`sdk:state`)
- [ ] Storage / export (`sdk:storage-room`, `sdk:export`)
- [ ] Embedded server / protocol (`sdk:server-ktor`, `sdk:server-api`)
- [ ] Web dashboard
- [ ] In-app UI (`sdk:ui-compose`, `sdk:ui-views`)
- [ ] Gradle plugin / build variants
- [ ] Sample apps
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other / not sure

## Additional context

Anything else — links, screenshots, related issues.
